_about: Organisations that are NOT businesses that buy athlete endorsements: NIL media and valuation sites, recruiting services, NIL marketplaces and platforms, sports media, governing bodies. Never a sponsor prospect. Matched case-insensitively as a whole phrase anywhere in a name ('&' and curly apostrophes normalised); a longer name that contains one is kept only when Google says it is a consumer business. Add a name here and every gate picks it up (services/notASponsor). Collectives have their own list: nilCollectives.json. Also conferences and governing bodies, NIL marketplaces, and event and media-rights companies (Players Era, Learfield): they run or sell around athletes, they do not buy endorsements.
